author: SinOfStrife
install_msg: Thanks for installing PKLens! Use the /pklens slash command for info, or right-click users to check PluralKit profiles and fronters.
name: PKLens
short: A privacy-focused PluralKit inspector for Discord context menus and slash commands.
description: View public PluralKit system profiles and current fronters using user-installed context menus and commands.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any personal data or Discord user IDs.
